criteria.name: Final ledger state
criteria.description: Gives the exact final label dense_lower_rated_short_window_subset and tests_passed = 4.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct label with an incorrect pass count, or the correct pass count with a near-equivalent label.

criteria.name: Local tornado and EF ledger
criteria.description: Reports 22 local tornadoes, EF-1 as the modal rating, and EF counts EF-U: 1, EF-0: 6, EF-1: 12, EF-2: 3.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right total and modal rating but incomplete counts; award 1 point for only the total.

criteria.name: Percentage calculations
criteria.description: Computes 81.8%, 93.2%, and 15.1% with correct numerators and denominators.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for two correct percentages; award 1 point for one correct percentage.

criteria.name: Threshold tests
criteria.description: Applies all four thresholds correctly, including the inclusive 10% to 20% local-share band.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for evaluating two or three thresholds correctly.

criteria.name: Timing and rating pattern
criteria.description: Connects the 24-hour concentration and lower-rated local mix to the final ledger state.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using only timing or only rating mix.

criteria.name: Compact output discipline
criteria.description: Returns the requested fields and avoids added casualty, loss, or track-geometry assertions not derived from the computed ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a mostly correct but verbose or partly missing output.
